name: Bad Music Bot
description: Telegram music bot with a mini WebApp room player + real Voice Chat streaming (PyTgCalls), like ShizuMusic.

OWNER_ID.description: Your numeric Telegram user ID (bot owner)

LOGGER_ID.description: Chat/channel ID where activity logs are sent

STRING_SESSION.description: Pyrogram session string for a normal Telegram USER account (assistant). Needed only for real Voice Chat streaming — leave empty to run web-room-only.

MONGO_URL.description: MongoDB connection URL (e.g. MongoDB Atlas). Leave empty to use a local database.json — note this resets on every Heroku dyno restart, so MongoDB is recommended for production.

WEBAPP_URL.description: Public base URL of this deployed app, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com (set this AFTER the first deploy, then restart the dyno)

MINIAPP_LINK.description: Telegram Mini App deep link for your bot, e.g. https://t.me/YourBot/app
